questions.q: Why did Joe ride Black Beauty that morning?
choices: To take a note from the master to a gentleman's house
To fetch Dr. White because the mistress was ill again
To give him some gentle exercise in the park
To bring back a load of bricks for the new stable
questions.evidence: the master wanted a note to be taken immediately to a gentleman's house

questions.q: What did Joe and Beauty see at the brick-field?
choices: A carter flogging two horses whose cart was stuck in mud
A runaway horse that had broken loose from its cart
A cart full of bricks that had tipped over in the lane
A fire that had broken out in one of the brick kilns
questions.evidence: the carter was shouting and flogging the two horses unmercifully

questions.q: What did Joe first offer to do to help the horses?
choices: Help lighten the cart
Pull the cart out with Beauty
Pay the carter some money
Fetch more horses from the farm
questions.evidence: I'll help you to lighten the cart

questions.q: The carter called Joe an "impudent young rascal." What does "impudent" mean here?
choices: Rude and too bold
Very kind and helpful
Shy and very quiet
Clever and wise for his age
questions.evidence: Mind your own business, you impudent young rascal

questions.q: What did Joe do after the carter refused to stop?
choices: Galloped to tell the master brick-maker, Mr. Clay
Rode straight home to Birtwick to tell John Manly
Jumped down and snatched the whip from the carter
Rode into the village to look for a policeman
questions.evidence: we were going at a round gallop toward the house of the master brick-maker

questions.q: What did John think about what Joe did?
choices: Joe did right, because stopping cruelty is everybody's business
Joe should have minded his own business and ridden on
Joe had ridden Beauty much too fast and been foolish
Joe ought to have stayed and fought the carter himself
questions.evidence: with cruelty and oppression it is everybody's business to interfere

questions.q: What happened to the carter after Joe gave his evidence?
choices: He was sent for trial and might go to prison
He was let off with a warning from the magistrate
He was given a lighter cart and two fresh horses
He came to Birtwick and said he was sorry to Joe
questions.evidence: the carter was committed to take his trial

questions.q: What did John mean when he said Joe "had grown an inch taller" that week?
choices: Joe had become more grown-up and sure of himself
Joe really had grown a great deal taller that week
Joe had taken to standing on a box to groom Beauty
Joe had a new pair of boots with thick heels
questions.evidence: as if he had jumped at once from a boy into a man
